title: Open Plant Floor common definitions
description: Definitions the Open Plant Floor schemas share: identifiers, the processes a machine performs, parameters with their units, quantities, the evidence grade a figure carries, and its source.

identifier.description: A stable identifier within its issuer's namespace, lower case, colon-separated segments (for example shop-1:laser-01).

process.description: What the operation does to the work, named by its process family.

parameter.description: A named parameter with its unit and the range or values it takes. Work is matched to equipment by comparing a job's parameters with a machine's.

name.description: The parameter, for example thickness, length, outer-diameter, wall-thickness, bend-length, force, material.

unit.description: SI unit symbol (mm, kN, kW, kg, s), or 'text' for a categorical value such as a material.

values.description: The discrete values it takes, when not a range.

unit.description: part, kit, lot, m, kg, or another counted unit.

evidence.description: How the figure is known: L0 estimate, L1 published benchmark, L2 quote or listing, L3 contracted or measured.

reference.description: Where the figure can be checked: a document title, a measurement record, a manufacturer specification.
